headline: Approved a litigation settlement by a 6-1 roll call vote.
summary: The meeting went into executive session to discuss a litigation settlement, item 26-174. Members then approved the settlement by a 6-1 roll call vote, with President Bears opposed.
decisions: Approved the settlement under item 26-174 by a 6-1 roll call vote, with President Bears opposed.

decision_evidence.quote: Motion by Councilor Scarpelli to approve settlement, seconded by Vice President Lazzaro. Approved on a Roll Call Vote of six in favor, one opposed (President Bears).

plain_text:

COMMITTEE OF THE WHOLE 
MEETING REPORT 
Tuesday, October 13, 2026 @ 6:30pm 
 
Call to Order and Roll Call 
 
President Bears called the meeting to order and requested the Clerk call the roll. Present were 
Councilor Callahan, Councilor Leming, Councilor Mullane, Councilor Tseng, Councilor Scarpelli, 
and Vice President Lazzaro. A quorum having been established, the Committee proceeded with 
the agenda. 
 
26-174 – Executive Session – Litigation Settlement 
Offered by Mayor Breanna Lungo Koehn 
 
Motion by Councilor Leming to enter into executive session pursuant to M.G.L. c. 30A, Section 
21(a)(3) with notice that votes may be taken and the Council will adjourn the meeting from 
executive session, seconded by Councilor Callahan. Approved on a Roll Call Vote of seven in 
favor, zero opposed. 
 
Motion by Councilor Scarpelli to approve settlement, seconded by Vice President Lazzaro. 
Approved on a Roll Call Vote of six in favor, one opposed (President Bears). 
 
Adjournment: 
 
Motion by Councilor Leming to Adjourn, seconded by Councilor Callahan. Approved on a roll 
call vote of seven in favor, zero opposed. 
 
Respectfully submitted, 
 
 
 
Laurel Siegel 
City Clerk
